summary: Exact candidate 454114868ff60985549c5602da2e440e41b78d3d fixes both independently reviewed freed-row counterexamples. On the recorded base, a freed overlap-lagged row gathered stale slot 101 instead of the -1 skip sentinel. The candidate returned -1 and also masked the corresponding non-track commit step. Candidate regressions and independent mixed, all-freed, explicit-position, live-row, and downstream-mask cases passed. This verifies the bounded scheduler/state-commit correction, but not the complete NVIDIA H20 Qwen3.6 serving incident.

At exact detached candidate 4541148, imported the helper from /job/repo and returned [-1, 202] on gfx950.
At exact candidate 4541148, 18 focused scheduler and verify-update tests passed.

On gfx950, explicit override with a freed row returned [-1, 201], a mixed live/freed default returned [101, -1], two freed rows returned [-1, -1], live rows remained [102, 201], and the downstream scatter received masked steps [-1, 4].

Only captured pytest text under the candidate's report/evidence directory contains trailing whitespace; no production or test source whitespace error was reported. This is non-functional review evidence formatting.

gpu_execution.evidence: Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 and ROCm 7.2.26015 executed the base failure and candidate passes on one AMD Instinct MI350X, gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-.

remaining_limitations: The original reporter used NVIDIA H20; only an AMD MI350X/gfx950 was assigned, so CUDA, NVIDIA FA3, and H20-specific execution were not tested.
Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-FP8 weights, the EAGLE draft model, the exact launch options, and the sustained two-request serving workload were unavailable.
No full-model HTTP-serving, semantic-accuracy, distributed, or soak claim is made. The deterministic tests qualify only the scheduler track-slot and recurrent-state commit boundaries.
No native rebuild was applicable: the candidate changes Python scheduler/backend code, Python tests, and reports only; it changes no native C++, CUDA, HIP, Triton, or FlyDSL source.

The recorded base already contains the earlier partial None-to-zero guard despite candidate 12863b77 not being an ancestor in this shallow prepared history. It avoids the reported TypeError but fails the stale-slot safety contract demonstrated here.
